run_limits._comment: Hard cap on NETWORK requests of one run (cache hits and TLS/DNS connection failures are not counted). Reaching it aborts the run (exit 4). scripts/collect_core.py --max-requests can only lower it; raising it is a reviewed config change.

unreachable_reason: recorded 2026-10-18 in the evidence round (connection/TLS failure or HTTP 403 on robots.txt); not retested, never contacted
youtube_transcripts_comment: D27: dropped. robots.txt disallows /youtubei/ and /api/, which youtube-transcript-api needs. The collector refuses to run (0 requests) while this is false.

policy_fetch._comment: D29: documentation pages fetched ONLY by scripts/fetch_policy_pages.py, one request per page, logged. Not a source of corpus text and not part of web_allowlist.

api_hosts._comment: D36/D37/D43: documented API endpoints that may skip the robots check (robots_exempt). Only these hosts and path prefixes are contacted (src/common/allowlist.py enforces it for every client built by make_http); a host may have several entries (one per path prefix). Terms evidence in docs/facts-layer.md. A 403, 406 or 429 stops the run.
